background_image_description: Cafe tabletop scene photographed indoors. A medium-dark wooden table occupies the lower half with a grey upholstered chair at left. On the table is a light wooden tray holding a dark glass of coffee and metal cutlery atop a white napkin; to the right is a white plate with a pastry. A thin, space grey laptop sits open toward the back-right, with keyboard visible. The upper half is a softly lit textured grey wall. Composition angled from front-left to back-right.

nodes.asset_description: Full-bleed photo of a cozy cafe workspace: wooden table, grey chair, open laptop, glass of coffee on a wooden tray with cutlery, and a pastry on a plate; neutral grey wall background.
